sections.title: Hero
sections.feedback: For the cards component in Hero, I was visualizing something much more like the animated cards fanned, like one of the variants that has the overlays and stuff like that in animated versions. Fanning them out and having them layered. While still center-aligned, you have one card in the middle. The two cards on the left and the two cards on the right are coming out in a kind of fan, going downwards, looking really good, with animated versions.
